description: You are investigating security-sensitive references to 'LEGACY_STRIPE_KEY' in the payment-service codebase. When you search the workspace using Find in Files (Ctrl+Shift+F) for 'LEGACY_STRIPE_KEY', you find results in src/billing.js, src/checkout.js, and .env files. However, you KNOW there is another file 'config/payment-providers.json' that contains this string (you can see it in the Explorer sidebar at /home/ga/workspace/payment-service/config/payment-providers.json and manually opening it confirms the text is there). Your task: (1) Investigate why config/payment-providers.json is excluded from workspace search results, (2) Modify the workspace settings file at .vscode/settings.json to include JSON config files in search (hint: check the search.exclude setting), (3) Ensure your fix doesn't accidentally include files that should remain excluded like node_modules, (4) Save the settings file. The file must be searchable after your changes.
